scope: Readout/reporting clarification only; locked training source and primary endpoints unchanged
A4_stage_loss: The inherited E8 receipt aggregates sum(losses[-512:])/512. Batch1024 operation stages have384 updates, so their recorded aggregate loss is scaled down by384/512. Recover the actual stage mean by multiplying that field by512/384. Composition has512 updates and needs no correction. No optimizer step uses this aggregate and no prediction gate depends on it.
all_other_arms: At least512 updates/stage; original denominator is correct.
policy: Preserve raw receipts; show corrected A4 mean loss explicitly in final report if loss is discussed. Do not infer improved loss from the uncorrected raw aggregate. This is not a scientific intervention or post-outcome tuning.
